title: Onboarding solution via bank transfer - Rampy

ms.promise:
Crafting the framework and technical infrastructure. This includes selecting a technologies, security protocols, compliance measures, and scalability solutions to ensure a secure and efficient exchange process. Implementing services infrastructure which are required in the background to operate as finance intermediary.
The available output is going to be a public api and documentation. User can authenticate, lookup available pairs and create an order. The API serves as the fundamental cornerstone of Rampy.
ms.criteria:
・Documentation is accessible
・API is accessible
・Users get access to the api with the provided client key
・Users can lookup available pairs (EUR -> ADA etc.)
・Users can create orders for available pairs
ms.report:
・Dokumentation & API: https://api.rampy.io
・Client Key: f31420e3b83e8ba282d9cbe0

The Video shows how the api can be used to create a challenge or orders, lookup pairs, orders, and create a new JWT token. https://drive.proton.me/urls/087D8WQNF4#YTOv2cTktPM7

ms.promise:
Website with wallet connector to securely sign-in and interact with Rampy.
The dApp provides access to Rampy via wallet connection. A user has to connect and sign a message to verify the ownership of the linked wallet to successfully sign-in. After successfully signing-in the user will be walked through the flow to create an order to buy ADA with EUR via bank transfer.
ms.criteria:
・Website offers a wallet connection
・Sign-in to Rampy by verifying ownership of the wallet by signing a message
・Users are able to create, read and delete orders
ms.report:
dApp is available at https://app.rampy.io or https://rampy.app.
Video demonstrating the dApp https://drive.google.com/file/d/1omYqRs0PuVD1lN6-JMddnDB7oHSb-ox1/view?usp=drive_link
update: the link should be accessible for anybody now. I am sorry for the wrong access level. 
Acceptance Criteria shown in the video:
・Wallet connection
・Signing a message to verify ownership of the wallet
・Create, Read and delete orders after signing in

Happy testing.

ms.promise: A simulation service for bank transfers and internally simulate compliance and exchange activities. Users can simulate a bank transfer by decided the origin bank account - IBAN and Name -, the amount in EUR and the purpose of the transfer. If the user has an associated order rampy is going to send funds to the users wallet.
ms.criteria:
・Users can simulate a bank transfer.
・Users receive tokens in their testnet wallet after simulating a valid bank transfer which can be linked to an order.
ms.report:
Simulation API: https://api.rampy.io/doc#/Simulation
Simulation Website: https://app.rampy.io/simulation
Video to showcase the simulation with valid transaction on Cardano Preview https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NY3DZGmx4T4XVgULvTll1G9z9n15zNgG/view
